correctness.rationale: The source relation is inclusion of complete classical truth sets. Closure of the language under negation turns inclusion into equality, so the relation is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive. Equivalence frames validate axiom 4. A standard three-world reflexive nontransitive model with an unconstrained predicate refutes axiom 4 while satisfying an allowed base theory, so the minimal FOT-based modal extension cannot be complete for the source's Section 5 frames.

value.rationale: The obstruction concerns the paper's final Kripke completeness theorem, not a peripheral lemma. It identifies a simple but decisive structural mismatch: all-formulas truth preservation in a classical language yields S5 equivalence classes, whereas the stated ambient modal setting is only FOT/T-strength. This sharply constrains any valid repair and prevents misuse of the claimed completeness theorem.
